Mobile Game

Pygmak

Pygmak is a survivors-style arcade game on the water where the player only steers: crates rain down in hordes, the flagship's gun aims itself, and every level up deals three cards to pick from (burn, freeze, electrify and dozens more), so each run builds differently. Three weapon classes, bosses every two and a half minutes, a final crate at 15:00, then endless mode. Built on realistic 2D physics so every shot, bounce and splash lands.

Features

  • Steer the flagship; the gun aims itself
  • Three weapon classes: cannon, laser, firework
  • Level-up card hands, chest evolutions and a gunboat convoy
  • Elites, ranked bosses, a 15-minute arc and endless mode
  • Corrupted crates: split, explode, mines, parachutes
  • Day/night cycle, seasons, workshop, skins and damage recap

Technologies

Unity 6 C# URP UI Toolkit Feel LevelPlay Ads Android
